name: Ybyrai Altynsarin
contribution: A major figure in pre-Soviet Kazakh history.
legacy: This person is also known as the author of the first Kazakh grammar book, the first Kazakh–Russian newspaper, and translator of a large number of textbooks and reference works.

checks.lead: Ybyrai Altynsarin (born Ibrahim Altynsarin; 1 November [O.S. 20 October] 1841 – 29 July [O.S. 17 July] 1889) was a major figure in pre-Soviet Kazakh history. He was the most prominent Kazakh educator of the 19th century, at the period of Russian colonization of and cultural influence in modern-day Kazakhstan.
